messages:
marie_cs: Quick weekly health for Beacon (onboarding cohort). Main items: p95/p99 split on route compose_long and rerank; streaming tails worse than sync. Need owners and mitigation before renewal check.
leo_se: pulled traces. compose_long / redwood-open-8k streaming shows p99 spikes around KV loads when chunks are very short. Sync path has higher baseline but lower tail.
tanya_sre: can you paste a tiny trace snippet?
leo_se: snippet:
```
trace: 0xabc123
route: compose_long
model: redwood-open-8k
mode: streaming
timing: queue 16ms -> kernel 50ms -> kv_load 140ms -> decode 20ms
observed p99: 1.4s
```
evan_onboard: Beacon said they recently switched to 150-200 token streaming chunks for perceived snappiness. That may be the cause.
marie_cs: risk is Medium. Usage/spend healthy but PM reported UX jitter. We should present short-term fix + plan.
leo_se: short-term: enable client-level prefix caching and bump streaming worker slots + increase max_chunk_tokens to 1000 for compose_long.
tanya_sre: long-term: reduce KV miss rate and consider model quantization or alternate kernel path. I'll run a KV miss query and share results.
opsbot: To run canary use `/deploy canary beacon-compose-cache`. Approval required.
evan_onboard: I'll coordinate with Beacon PM for an A/B that reduces chunking frequency. They agreed to test.
marie_cs: Action items:
- leo_se: apply conservative prefix_cache + worker bump canary today. (owner)
- tanya_sre: KV miss telemetry and kernel timings, report in 3h. (owner)
- evan_onboard: confirm Beacon A/B test and collect prompt samples. (owner)
- marie_cs: update renewal notes with mitigation + next steps. (owner)
leo_se: planned canary patch below (will monitor p95/p99):
```
PATCH /configs/clients/beacon
{
  "routes": {
    "compose_long": {
      "streaming": {
        "prefix_cache": true,
        "stream_workers": 6,
        "max_chunk_tokens": 1000
      }
    }
  }
}
```
opsbot: Canary started -> beacon-compose-cache -> node-2
leo_se: initial canary: p99 for streaming compose_long reduced 1.4s -> 0.95s, p95 improved slightly. KV miss pct down ~20%.
tanya_sre: telemetry snippet (minute-level):
```
09:50, kv_miss_pct: 3.2, p95_stream_ms: 480, p99_stream_ms: 950
09:49, kv_miss_pct: 4.6, p95_stream_ms: 610, p99_stream_ms: 1400
```
tanya_sre: conclusion: prefix cache helps. Recommend follow-up ticket for cache key refinement and exploring quantized inference for redwood-open-8k.
emma_onboard: Beacon PM will run A/B for 48h and share results.
marie_cs: good progress. If stable for 24h, we'll mark latency risk as mitigated for renewal packet. Add final numbers after 24h.
opsbot: Auto-note: thread will be archived after 7 days of inactivity.
